digest.component_or_area: bridge reconciliation runner and CI workflows
propositions: Extract production bridge wrapper logic into a single runner-neutral Python entrypoint at scripts/run_reconcile_bridge.py that accepts MODE values and routes them to legacy or canonical rebar commands.

Preserve backward compatibility: legacy callers invoking rebar reconcile --mode directly continue to observe 3/4/75 exit codes; only the runner wrapper translates benign 3/4/75 results to provider result 0.
The runner owns environment validation, 3600-second timeout, BRIDGE_RUN_ID validation, BRIDGE_PAUSED marker detection, and strict delivery invocation with commit message inclusion.
Thin GitHub Actions, Jenkins, and GitLab provider wrappers to perform only checkout, credential materialization, signing-key setup, masking, artifacts, notifications, scheduling, and result mapping.

Vendor GitLab Draft-07 CI schema at immutable commit with verified SHA-256 provenance and offline validation; pin shellcheck-py 0.11.0.1 and validate extracted shell bodies across all three provider configs.

Retarget existing workflow tests to verify runner/provider contract, result mapping against _Disposition, shallow-repository rejection, and identical output across a five-environment matrix with scrubbed vendor variables and no gh CLI.
